allowed_changes_only: Use a standard browser User-Agent and normal browser request headers.
Bootstrap a normal unauthenticated Upbit web session and retain ordinary response cookies.
Use curl instead of urllib for HTTP transport if required.
forbidden_changes: No proxy rotation, CAPTCHA bypass, authentication, private API, scraping-evasion service, or access-control circumvention.
No market price or outcome access.

probe.failure: Any persistent non-200 or schema failure closes this GitHub-hosted official route as SOURCE_ACCESS_BLOCKED
